description: List the authors the tradition names, grouped by period, each with a short note and the books credited to them. Call it when the user asks who wrote something, or wants the works of one acharya; pass the author's `id` to list_works to see the books. Filter by `era`: shruti, classical, caitanya, successors, modern.

era.description: Only the authors of this period.

language.description: Preferred language of the translations returned. Not a filter: works that exist only in Russian are returned in Russian, and each result says which language it is actually in. Default: en.

name: list_authors
title: List the authors in the library
